title: execution_permission
description: A bundle's envelope/execution_permission.json: what the lab's confirmed policy lets the built agent run on its own, copied by the Designer from the lab profile the build names, never inferred. The gate reads `reaches`, a value, and no sentence. Levels, each including the one before: none, mock, sandbox, engine, instrument. A tool whose gate opens_by execution_permission runs where `reaches` is engine or instrument; instrument opens no tool that changes an instrument, which stays behind safety values (MP4). A tool that reaches the network opens by the permission only to install packages from a source listed under package_sources, or to read data from hosts listed under data_sources (tasks/023), and neither list opens the other.

words.description: the confirmed value of the profile, as it stands there

engines.description: the engines (ids of contracts/registry/engines.json) a person allowed this source for alone (the person, 2026-11-18, docs/ideas/20261118.md, 'Yes, covered'); a source without it serves any engine the permission reaches

package_sources.description: the installers and channels a person allowed a built agent to fetch its own packages from (the person, 2026-11-16: pixi from conda-forge). A tool that reaches the network opens by the permission only to install from one of these.

host.description: a bare lower-case host name, matched by equality: no scheme, port, path or wildcard

data_sources.description: the hosts a person allowed every agent built for the lab to read data from, read-only and anonymously (the person, 2026-11-17, 'Every agent of this lab', docs/ideas/20261117.md; tasks/023). A tool that reaches the network opens by the permission to fetch only where every host its contract names under fetches_from is listed here with the same access. A host here opens no install.
